title: 人生中我对犯错的心态 #pua #dating

timeline.summary: Mikey introduces mistakes as a form of experience and says his stance is to accept the consequences of his own errors.

He says he does not regret his decisions or doubt his judgment; when events go against his wishes, he attributes that to insufficient capability at the time and says capability can be improved. Dense subtitles resolve the ASR errors as '提升能力，仅此而已'.

He says he would still make the original choice, because a present self cannot fairly judge the past self, who was also confused; he closes by telling viewers not to destroy themselves through self-attack.
The spoken argument has ended; no additional semantic content is present before the media ends.

claims.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
claims.statement: He treats mistakes as experience and pairs self-forgiveness with willingness to bear the consequences of one's decisions.
claims.conditions: Bearing consequences must include repair and changed behavior where others were harmed; self-forgiveness does not erase responsibility.

claims.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
claims.statement: He interprets an unwanted result as evidence that his capability at that time was insufficient and says capability can be improved rather than turning the result into global self-condemnation.
claims.conditions: This framing is useful only when it also tests whether the original judgment, goal and impact were wrong; not every bad outcome is solved by becoming more capable at the same choice.

claims.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
claims.statement: He argues against judging the past self solely from present hindsight and urges viewers not to engage in self-destructive self-attack.
claims.conditions: A self-compassion stance; it does not require repeating the same choice or refusing to update beliefs when new evidence appears.

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey (visual/channel continuity)
speaker_attribution.basis: One on-camera narrator speaks throughout; face and presentation match the channel's formal Mikey talking-head sources. No second speaker or quoted message appears.

visual_findings: All 14 sampled frames show the same man speaking while walking on a public street, with editorial Chinese subtitles.
No concrete mistake, affected person, repair action or later result is shown; the visuals do not establish that any decision was harmless or correct.
Seven 2-fps frames from 21.0-24.5 seconds confirm '慢慢提升能力，仅此而已'; eight frames from 37.0-41.0 seconds confirm '不要去自我破坏OK', correcting the ASR errors.

permissions.reason: The usable mistake-feedback and self-compassion method is already represented; the absolute refusal to regret or doubt one's judgment needs a strong responsibility and belief-update boundary.

limitations: The automatic transcript was not checked word-for-word against original audio; three garbled phrases were resolved from embedded subtitles only.
Sparse and targeted dense frames are not continuous audio-visual review.
The clip provides no concrete decision, affected party or repair process, so 'buying the consequences' cannot be evaluated.
The phrases 'never regret' and 'never doubt my judgment' are absolutes that conflict with the need to learn from evidence and repair preventable harm.
